KernSmooth

CRAN 2.23-27

All seven public functions are done: bkde, bkde2D, bkfe, dpih, dpik, dpill, and locpoly. bkde2D loads the Rust crate lbtwod. dpill loads blkest, cp, rlbin, sdiag, and sstdiag, and calls locpoly. sdiag and sstdiag use linpack. Density binning still uses linbin. Kernel weights and the FFT use NumPy.

bkdetranslated—linbin not yetBinned kernel density estimate. Signature matches KernSmooth::bkde and returns x and y. Kernel weights, default bandwidth, and FFT are Python on NumPy. Bin counts come from the linbin crate. Uses numpy, linbin.
bkde2Dtranslated—lbtwod not yetTwo-dimensional binned kernel density estimate. Signature matches KernSmooth::bkde2D and returns x1, x2, and fhat. Bin counts come from the lbtwod crate. The bivariate normal kernel and the 2D FFT stay in NumPy. Uses numpy, lbtwod.
bkfetranslated—linbin not yetBinned kernel functional estimate. Signature matches KernSmooth::bkfe and returns one number. Normal-kernel weights and the FFT are Python on NumPy. Bin counts come from the linbin crate when the data are not already binned. Uses numpy, linbin.
dpihtranslated—linbin not yetDirect plug-in histogram bin width. Signature matches KernSmooth::dpih and returns one number. Bin counts come from linbin. The plug-in functionals come from bkfe. Uses numpy, linbin, bkfe.
dpiktranslated—linbin not yetDirect plug-in bandwidth for a kernel density estimate. Signature matches KernSmooth::dpik and returns one number. Bin counts come from linbin. The plug-in functionals come from bkfe. Uses numpy, linbin, bkfe.
dpilltranslated—blkest not yet, cp not yet, rlbin not yet, sdiag not yet, sstdiag not yetDirect plug-in bandwidth for local linear regression. Signature matches KernSmooth::dpill and returns one number. Pairs are binned with rlbin. Blocked quartic fits come from blkest and cp. Smoother diagonals come from sdiag and sstdiag. Pilot smooths use locpoly. Uses numpy, blkest, cp, rlbin, sdiag, sstdiag, locpoly.
locpolytranslated—linbin not yet, rlbin not yet, locpol not yetLocal polynomial density and regression estimate. Signature matches KernSmooth::locpoly and returns x and y. Density bin counts come from the existing linbin crate. Regression bin counts come from rlbin. The fit comes from locpol, which calls linpack. Uses numpy, linbin, rlbin, locpol.
